title: California's $114m wildlife bridge records coyote believed to make first full crossing
summary_full: In an exciting development, a coyote has been spotted utilizing a newly constructed wildlife bridge spanning California's US 101 Freeway. This innovative structure is designed to reconnect fragmented habitats caused by highways and urbanization. Researchers are actively observing wildlife interactions with the bridge through remote cameras, aiming to enhance the migration of various species, such as mountain lions and deer.
